channel.title: Timothy Davies
channel.description: Writing and agentic experience patterns by Timothy Davies.

item.title: What agentic experience looks like inside the enterprise
item.description: The journey doesn’t disappear when agents arrive. It moves into decisions someone has to design.

item.title: What a voice agent should never say aloud
item.description: Six principles for designing voice and multimodal agents for people on the move.

item.title: An agent that excludes people isn’t finished
item.description: Voice, text, touch and sign: what accessible agentic design asks of us.

item.title: 827 million fans. One clear answer.
item.description: How the Formula 1 fan companion came together, experience first.

item.title: Pattern: Vital before visual
item.description: Speak only what the person needs right now. Everything else waits for a screen.

item.title: Pattern: Read back what commits
item.description: If an action spends money, places an order or changes a record, the agent says it back and waits.

item.title: Pattern: Three per turn
item.description: A spoken answer never lists more than three things. If there are more, it offers them.

item.title: Pattern: Designed refusals
item.description: Decide what the agent won’t answer, and make saying no as well designed as saying yes.

item.title: Pattern: Approved sources only
item.description: The agent answers from a defined set of sources, and the experience makes that visible.

item.title: Pattern: Explain the suggestion
item.description: When an agent recommends something, it shows the evidence behind it.

item.title: Pattern: Coach, don’t score
item.description: When an agent assesses someone’s work, it points to the next improvement rather than handing down a grade.

item.title: Pattern: Structure inside the conversation
item.description: When the agent needs precise details, it brings a small form into the conversation instead of asking question after question.

item.title: Pattern: Every mode, one experience
item.description: The same experience works through voice, text, touch and sign, so nobody is shut out by the mode they use.
